source_note: Official MIST tarballs. Canonical host is https://mist.science/data/ (waps.cfa.harvard.edu/MIST is a legacy alias that 302-redirects there). The upstream publishes no checksums; sha256 is computed at download time and recorded in each MANIFEST. Inventory verified live on 2026-10-11: /data/ holds exactly tarballs_v1.2/ and tarballs_v2.5/ (no v1.0/v1.1/v2.0 tarball directories).
scope_note: The catalog covers the isochrone theory products only: full and basic isochrone tarballs for every published composition set. The EEPS track tarballs and the per-photometric-system isochrone repackages are out of scope: stellariso consumes isochrones, not tracks, and synthetic photometry is beyond its purpose. Rotation is published only as vvcrit 0.0 and 0.4 in every directory.
excluded: v2.5 feh_p050 x afe_p0.6 EEPS tarballs (both rotations): linked on the model_grids page but absent from the published directory (404 upstream, verified 2026-10-11); not in this catalog
per-photometric-system isochrone tarballs (24 systems for v1.2, 27 for v2.5): out of scope (synthetic photometry)
EEPS evolutionary-track tarballs (30 for v1.2, 166 for v2.5): out of scope; stellariso catalogs isochrone products only

format_notes.isochrones: MIST .iso theoretical isochrone table: '#' commented header, one 'number of EEPs, cols' line per isochrone age block, column names on the '# EEP ...' line, whitespace-separated rows; each block's age is carried by the log10_isochrone_age_yr column.
